$comment: Every label in the repo. `pnpm labels:sync` makes GitHub match this file (dry run by default, --apply to change). `renamedFrom` renames an old label instead of creating a new one, so its issues and PRs keep it. `remove` lists labels to delete. See "Labels" in CLAUDE.md.

groups.rule: exactly one on every issue and PR

labels.name: team-1
labels.description: Owned by Team 1

labels.name: team-2
labels.description: Owned by Team 2

labels.name: team-3
labels.description: Owned by Team 3

labels.name: team-4
labels.description: Owned by Team 4

labels.name: platform
labels.description: Shared platform in server/: stack, infra, CI, tooling

labels.name: team-instructor
labels.description: Owned by the instructor team

groups.rule: exactly one; set by the issue template, and on PRs by the labeller

labels.name: type:feature
labels.description: New behaviour or capability

labels.name: type:bug
labels.description: Something is broken or behaves wrongly

labels.name: type:docs
labels.description: Documentation, rules or guides

labels.name: type:chore
labels.description: Tooling, CI, dependencies or tests

labels.name: type:refactor
labels.description: Restructure without changing behaviour

labels.name: type:release
labels.description: Release main to prod

labels.name: type:sync
labels.description: Bring a feature/team-N branch up to date with main

groups.rule: exactly one on every PR; set by the labeller from the diff

labels.name: size:tiny
labels.description: At most 20 changed lines and 2 files

labels.name: size:small
labels.description: At most 150 changed lines

labels.name: size:medium
labels.description: At most 400 changed lines

labels.name: size:large
labels.description: Over 400 lines, or changes the shared contract, dependencies or CI

labels.name: priority:p0
labels.description: Blocks the demo or every team: fix now

labels.name: priority:p1
labels.description: Important: fix soon

labels.name: priority:p2
labels.description: Minor: fix when there is time

groups.rule: on open PRs only; set by the labeller every 10 minutes. At most one waiting-on.* label

labels.name: stackpile
labels.description: Stacked on another PR: its base is not main, prod or a feature/team-N branch

labels.name: waiting-on.author
labels.description: Changes requested, an unresolved review thread, or a draft

labels.name: waiting-on.review
labels.description: Needs an approving review from someone other than the author

labels.name: waiting-on.merge
labels.description: Approved with nothing open: ready to merge

labels.name: cross-team
labels.description: Changes another team's files; the issue explains why

labels.name: blocked
labels.description: Waiting on something outside this issue or PR

labels.name: duplicate
labels.description: Already covered by another issue or PR

labels.name: wontfix
labels.description: Will not be worked on
